name: questasim-compiler-simulator
description: Compile and simulate Verilog/SystemVerilog projects with QuestaSim or ModelSim.

questa.vsimPath.description: Absolute path to the QuestaSim/ModelSim vsim executable. Leave empty to use vsim from PATH.

questa.vlogPath.description: Absolute path to vlog. If empty, it is derived from vsimPath or resolved from PATH.

questa.topModule.description: Top-level module or entity to simulate, for example alu_tb.

questa.simulationDirectory.description: Directory, relative to the workspace, where Questa work libraries and generated scripts are kept.

questa.sourceListFile.description: Source-list filename, relative to the workspace.

questa.runDoFile.description: Generated run.do filename, relative to the simulation directory.

questa.simulationMode.description: Run vsim in console mode or the Questa graphical interface.

questa.autoGenerateSourceList.description: Regenerate sources.f after HDL files are created, changed, renamed, or deleted.

questa.excludedDirectories.description: Directory names excluded when discovering HDL files.

questa.sourceOrder.description: Optional ordered glob patterns used before the default header/package/RTL/testbench ordering.

questa.includeDirectories.description: Include directories, relative to the workspace or absolute, passed to vlog as +incdir+ arguments.

questa.macroDefinitions.description: Macro definitions passed to vlog as +define+NAME or +define+NAME=VALUE arguments.

questa.additionalVlogArguments.description: Additional vlog arguments. Each array entry is one argument.

questa.additionalVsimArguments.description: Additional vsim arguments. Each array entry is one argument.

questa.useIntegratedTerminal.description: Launch simulations in a VS Code integrated terminal instead of streaming them to the QuestaSim Output channel.
